Study_Name: Exposure to endocrine-disrupting plasticisers and lung function in children and adolescents: A systematic review and meta-analysis
Item_1_Comment: Only formula reported are log rescaling (in the Method section)
Item_2_Comment: In the abstract: "We employed a random-effects meta-analysis on spirometry measures. "
Item_5_Comment:
in the Results section:

We found 176 studies, and after duplicates were removed, we screened 80 titles and abstracts for inclusion. After screening 41 full texts for eligibility, we excluded ten conference abstracts, four studies with an adult population, one with the wrong exposure, and one with the wrong study design (e.g., cohort profile). Our review included 25 studies, of which 17 met the inclusion criteria for the meta-analysis
